# wellbeing_enabled_languages (Data Source)

Languages enabled for the company. The numeric `id` is the language key used in survey question texts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wellbeing_enabled_languages" "this" {}

output "language_ids_by_code" {
  value = {
    for language in data.wellbeing_enabled_languages.this.languages :
    language.code => language.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `languages` (Attributes List) Enabled languages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--languages))

<a id="nestedatt--languages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `languages`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Language code, for example `en`.
- `id` (Number) Language ID, for example `1045`.
- `label` (String) Display name, for example `English`.
